comments.author: @francesmaraamaya6683
comments.text: My every morning is a struggle to focus and do my quiet and prayer time with the Lord. I feel guilty when I set Him aside for something else.

comments.author: @cathrinemarasigan
comments.text:
Brother Bo, I really felt this message is for me. I want to share an experience two weeks ago. But it may be a little gross to some.

In the middle of intense habagat and thigh high flood. Me and my two sons decided to still go to church because we had experience moments when we literally "live through prayers"-and because of that, if we still can, we will go to church every Sunday.
It began 2am, Sunday. I heat water, prepare breakfast. Woke up my sons, and at 5am set to walk for 1.25 km thigh high flooded road to catch up with the 6am mass. Half way to church, my stomach felt so upset. I decided to continue since there is a gasoline station nearby. But sadly they told me that their comfort room is out of order because they don't have any water. I am sweating so hard from rain and from the energy I have to give to keep my anal opening close.
I was so devastated, I told my sons, you go ahead to church, reserve me a seat.
I prayed brother Bo. I told God. Lord I will find a place to relieve myself, but please do not let me be late for mass.
I ran to the market's public toilet. Release everything, then ran towards the church.
God was so good, that by the time I reach the front door of our church, it is still the entrance procession towards the alter. So I quickly ran towards my son, and join them. But my shirt was so wet, I couldn't concentrate on the mass. I am so conscious , I am fanning myself so hard just to dry the shirt.
After the mass i was so sad. I am thinking if everything was worth it or did I just made a fool out of myself.
But with today's message in full tank. I was relieve that God sees my efforts not my physical condition (that seems more suitable in a pool rather than in a church). God bless and protect us all.

comments.author: @randyvidal1057
comments.text:
Lord Jesus Christ, you refresh us with your presence and you sustain us with your life-giving word. Show us how to lift the burden of others, especially those who lack the basic necessities of life, and to refresh them with humble care and service. Amen. He saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of his mercy. He saved us through the washing of rebirth and renewal by the Holy Spirit, whom he poured out on us generously through Jesus Christ our Savior, so that, having been justified by his grace, we might become heirs having the hope of eternal life. Titus 3:5–7, NIV
Lord our God, let your light shine in our hearts, the light that can gladden us and lead us until all our longing is stilled. May the higher nature born in us become ever stronger so that the lower and perishable nature does not rule over us. Grant that we may overcome and that our hearts may rejoice in being allowed to strive for the highest good because we are your children who can share in what is eternal. In Jesus Christ Name.Amen.
